content.text: {"title":"Ravi and the two arms","gradeSubjectTag":"Class 8 · Science","readMinutes":2,"scenes":[{"label":"hook","text":"Ravi found a picture of a chromosome in his science book at home."},{"label":"problem","text":"He wanted to know what the two matching halves were called and what joined them."},{"label":"mathMoment","text":"His sister explained that the halves are chromatids and the joining point is the centromere."},{"label":"wrapUp","text":"Ravi was happy to be able to name every part of the picture."}],"visual":{"type":"library","id":"human-eye"},"equations":[],"tryTogether":{"question":"What are the two matching halves called?","answer":"Chromatids"},"parentPrompt":"Ask your child to name the two halves."}
